text_markup: The Corp, playing {card:MirrorMorph: Endless Iteration}, plays {card:Hedge Fund} as the first action of their turn, then plays {card:Lateral Growth}. Even though two different cards were played, both times the Corp used the basic action to "Play 1 operation from HQ". Since their first two actions were the same, the Corp will not be able to trigger the ability on MirrorMorph this turn.
